title: Beatrix and the Tide
author: Felix Underhill
blurb: Cyrus Fairweather, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
